name: Coe

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant Keith Adam Coe, 30, killed in Khalis, Iraq, on April 27, 2010, by an explosive device. Ten rounds of thrusters and ring push-ups — pressing volume stacked past what feels reasonable, on purpose.

description: Ten rounds of 10 thrusters and 10 ring push-ups — a barbell-and-gymnastics couplet repeated at high round count.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/coe (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
